Description: Verify that when a user adds an item, it correctly appears in the cart

Description: Verify that a valid checkout flow completes the order successfully

Description: Verify that a locked-out user cannot log in and sees the correct error message

Description: Verify that a valid login navigates the user to the Products page

Description: Verify that the correct confirmation message is displayed after successful checkout

Description: Verify that the Products page loads after login and displays available items

Description: Verify that removing an item from the cart makes it empty

Description: Verify that adding a product updates the cart badge count correctly
